ops.title: cc-notes is NOT exposed to the fleet stale-launchd-Program bug; daemonkit v0.20 adoption is a separate modernization
ops.body:
2026-07-24 fleet audit correction: the daemonkit stale-Program blast-radius table listed cc-notes as vulnerable via service.CanonicalExecutable() at internal/helperclient/deployment_identity.go:219 and internal/helperapp/identity.go:55. Both attributions are wrong: the former hashes the invoking binary for the deployment consumer-build identity (a content digest, never a stored path); the latter is the in-.app self-location proof and must not change. The only production service.Agent is the FuseKit .app helper's, fed by the deployment package (version-stable by design). The main CLI registers no launchd agents at all — internal/helperapp/release_contract_test.go:163-166 actively forbids service.NewController/launchctl in deployment.go. No stale-path exposure exists; cc-notes was dropped from the StableProgram adoption sweep.

Adopting daemonkit v0.20 here later is an architectural migration, not a bump: supervise was deleted in daemonkit v0.12 (imported at helperapp/identity.go:14, helperclient/runner.go:14), the deployment Deploy/Deactivate/Config API was removed in v0.15-v0.17 (helperdeployment/deployment.go carries 26 references, pinned by release_contract_test.go:141-153), and fusekit v1.12.0 transitively pins daemonkit v0.10.0 (fusekit must migrate first).
